S1.text: Black Friday has a clever trick. It can make spending feel like saving. Today, Alex heads into the sales with a three hundred dollar budget and two very different plans. One plan ends at three hundred and forty-one dollars. The other ends at two hundred and sixty-three. Same shop, same sales, seventy-eight dollars apart. Along the way, you'll get five simple rules for your own Black Friday, and none of them say never buy anything. Let's see what happens.
